mapper.sql: select id, user_code, courseseq, plan_day, plandetail_id, plan_id, plan_startdate, plan_enddate, plan_state, plan_choose, plan_unique from yh_user_healthy_plan
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT id FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` WHERE user_code=#{usercode} GROUP BY plan_id) AS a
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` WHERE user_code=#{usercode}
select count(*) from yh_user_healthy_plan where DATE_FORMAT(plan_startdate, '%Y%m' ) = DATE_FORMAT( CURDATE( ) , '%Y%m' )
where plan_unique=#{planUnique} ORDER BY plan_startdate
SELECT plan_allnumber FROM `yh_healthy_plan` WHERE id=#{planId}

SELECT b.`user_code` AS usercode,b.`user_name` AS username,b.`name`,a.`plan_startdate` AS planStrTime,c.`plan_name` AS planName,a.`courseseq`,d.`plan_num` AS planNum,a.`plan_day` AS planDay ,a.`plan_state` AS planState
FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN `yh_user_reginfo` AS b ON a.`user_code`=b.`user_code` INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plan` AS c ON a.`plan_id`=c.`id` INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plandays` AS d ON a.`plan_id`=d.`plan_id` AND a.`plan_day`=d.`planday` INNER JOIN `yh_user_make_card` AS e ON e.user_code=a.`user_code`
and e.doctor=(SELECT id FROM `yh_user_admin_info` WHERE user_code=#{usercode}) and a.courseseq!=0
AND c.`plan_name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{planName},'%')
AND b.`name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{nameLike},'%')
AND b.`user_name` LIKE CONCAT('%',#{usernameLike},'%')
AND a.plan_startdate BETWEEN #{strtime} AND #{endtime}
ORDER BY a.plan_startdate DESC

SELECT a.`user_code` AS usercode,a.id,c.`plan_name` AS planName,a.`plan_startdate` AS planStrTime,a.`courseseq`,b.plandetail_id AS plandetailId,b.plan_num AS planNum,a.`plan_unique` AS planUnique,a.`plan_day` AS planDay,a.`plan_id` AS planId FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN yh_healthy_plandays AS b ON a.`plan_id`=b.`plan_id` AND a.`plan_day`=b.planday and a.`courseseq`!=0
AND a.`courseseq`<= b.plan_num
AND a.`courseseq`>= b.plan_num
INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plan` AS c ON a.`plan_id`=c.id
a.user_code=#{usercode}
and a.plan_startdate between #{strTime} and #{endTime}
and c.`plan_name` like concat('%',#{planName},'%')
order by a.plan_startdate desc

SELECT a.plan_startdate AS planStrTime,a.courseseq,b.plan_num AS planNum FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plandays` AS b ON a.`plan_id` = b.`plan_id` AND a.`plan_day` = b.planday WHERE a.user_code = #{usercode} and a.courseseq!=0 ORDER BY a.plan_startdate

SELECT a.plan_startdate AS planStrTime,a.courseseq,b.plan_num AS planNum FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plandays` AS b ON a.`plan_id` = b.`plan_id` AND a.`plan_day` = b.planday WHERE a.user_code = #{usercode} AND plan_unique=#{planUnique} ORDER BY a.plan_startdate
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` WHERE plan_unique=#{planUnique} and user_code=#{usercode}
SELECT plandetail_id FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT plandetail_id FROM `yh_healthy_plandays` WHERE plan_id=#{planId} AND planday=#{planDay}
SELECT plandetail_title FROM `yh_healthy_plandetail` WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT a.planNum,a.planStrTime,a.planName,a.planState,MAX(planRunDay) AS planRunDay FROM (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT * FROM yh_user_healthy_plan WHERE user_code = #{usercode} GROUP BY plan_unique) AS a) AS planNum, a.`plan_startdate` AS planStrTime, b.`plan_name` AS planName, a.`plan_day` AS planRunDay, a.plan_state as planState FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plan` AS b ON a.`plan_id` = b.`id` WHERE (a.plan_state = 1 or a.plan_state = 0) and (a.plan_state!=0 or a.courseseq!=0) AND a.user_code = #{usercode} OR (a.user_code = #{usercode} and a.plan_state=0 AND plan_day=1) ) AS a

SELECT a.planNum,a.planStrTime,a.planName,a.planState,MAX(planRunDay) AS planRunDay FROM (SELECT (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM (SELECT * FROM yh_user_healthy_plan WHERE user_code = #{usercode} GROUP BY plan_unique) AS a) AS planNum, a.`plan_startdate` AS planStrTime, b.`plan_name` AS planName, a.`plan_day` AS planRunDay, a.plan_state as planState FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plan` AS b ON a.`plan_id` = b.`id` WHERE (a.plan_state = 1 or a.plan_state = 0) and (a.plan_state!=0 or a.courseseq!=0) AND a.user_code = #{usercode} ) AS a

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MAX(a.plan_day) AS planRunDay,CASE WHEN a.plan_state = '1' THEN '已开始' WHEN a.plan_state = '2' THEN '已结束' WHEN a.plan_state = '3' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未开始' END AS planState,a.`plan_name` AS planName,a.`plan_startdate` AS planStrTime,a.plan_unique AS planUnique FROM (SELECT a.`plan_day`,a.`plan_startdate`,a.`plan_state`,b.`plan_name`,a.plan_unique FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plan` AS b ON a.`plan_id`=b.`id` WHERE a.user_code=#{usercode} and (a.plan_state!=0 or a.courseseq!=0) ORDER BY a.`plan_startdate`) AS a GROUP BY a.`plan_unique` HAVING MAX(a.plan_day) ) AS b ORDER BY b.planStrTime DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT MAX(a.plan_day) AS planRunDay,CASE WHEN a.plan_state = '1' THEN '已开始' WHEN a.plan_state = '2' THEN '已结束' WHEN a.plan_state = '3' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未开始' END AS planState,a.`plan_name` AS planName,a.`plan_startdate` AS planStrTime,a.plan_unique AS planUnique FROM (SELECT a.`plan_day`,a.`plan_startdate`,a.`plan_state`,b.`plan_name`,a.plan_unique FROM `yh_user_healthy_plan` AS a INNER JOIN `yh_healthy_plan` AS b ON a.`plan_id`=b.`id` WHERE a.user_code=#{usercode} and (a.plan_state!=0 or a.courseseq!=0) ORDER BY a.`plan_startdate`) AS a GROUP BY a.`plan_unique` HAVING MAX(a.plan_day) ) AS b ORDER BY b.planStrTime DESC
where id = #{id}
